findings.evidence: description names Node, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby, Java, and .NET but not the manifest keywords package.json, pyproject.toml, go.mod, Cargo.toml, Gemfile, pom.xml or csproj
findings.fix: Audit, diagnose, and conservatively update project dependencies and lockfiles for Node (package.json), Python (pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, Pipfile), Go (go.mod), Rust (Cargo.toml), Ruby (Gemfile), Java (pom.xml, build.gradle), and .NET (csproj). Auto-applies safe minor and patch updates after a recoverable snapshot, with tests and a security audit per cohort, and asks before every major, 0.x or prerelease change. Use when asked to update dependencies, update the safe ones automatically, find outdated packages, resolve dependency conflicts, or remediate vulnerable packages, even when the user only names a lockfile or a failing install. Not for runtime upgrades, package publishing, or Renovate configuration.
